component.name: Warehouse COSMIC
component.summary: Manage Flatpak apps with a native interface and CLI

description.p: Manage Flatpak apps with a native graphical interface and CLI. Inspired by flattool/Warehouse and built with Rust and libcosmic. Search installed applications and runtimes, manage remotes, check updates, change package sources, and create or restore app-data snapshots.
The desktop interface runs on Wayland with GPU rendering when available. The standalone CLI provides command discovery, JSON schemas, dry-run plans and scripts without a server.
Package management needs host command access. This application can change your Flatpak installations and read or modify files in your home directory.
Initial native desktop interface and standalone automation CLI.
